links.outcome: Impression generation performance after removing 20%, 50%, 80% of report text
links.effect: All models showed performance decline with incomplete text. Text-only complete-report ROUGE-L was 0.23 (OpenFlamingo) vs 0.21 (MedFlamingo) vs 0.21 (IDEFICS). Multimodal input mitigated decline for MedFlamingo and IDEFICS (p<0.001).
links.quote: All models exhibited performance decline with incomplete data.

unlisted_practices: Adding images (multimodal input) to mitigate performance loss from incomplete text input

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating the robustness and hallucination rates of multimodal LLMs vs. text-only LLMs on chest X-ray reports with missing contextual information using MIMIC-CXR data.
